significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would license the sentence that an edit-free "principal-subspace angle / CCA correlation" predicts which logically entailed facts will inherit an edit, while "aligning the subspaces" causally restores propagation across low-coupling seams; this combines a form-(iii) predictive coupling with a form-(ii) mechanism rather than merely asserting that facts are represented. It would establish both a behavioral phenomenon—pre-existing coupling forecasts later ripple success—and a mechanistic explanation fixing which pairs should fail across editing methods; RippleEdits (Cohen et al., 2023) and MQuAKE (Zhong et al., 2023) show that propagation to related and multi-hop facts is a concrete unresolved evaluation target. The branches are determinate: failure to beat frequency/hop controls together with failure of alignment would rule out low-rank linear "consistency seams" as a substantial account for the eligible relations, although it would not exclude nonlinear organization. In the topic-substitution check, the broad question of how knowledge is organized would not merit this score by itself; the specific pre-edit predictive law and linked causal account are what place the claim above the topic median.

reach.justification: The transferable handle is the "static, edit-free coupling score," which is explicitly ex ante because it is computed with "no edit, no target answer, and no gradients" and can support "routing edits away from seam-blocked facts" or "flagging brittle facts before editing." After per-model re-extraction, the conclusion predicts a relation—lower alignment should mean lower ripple probability—rather than merely supplying an open-ended procedure for finding some direction, so its substantive content can survive recalibration. Its asserted scope spans editing methods and held-out relation families and supplies a usable screening signal to researchers and practitioners who audit or deploy editing systems, though applicability is expressly restricted to "linearly-decodable relations" and is not claimed for frontier models generally. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: generic knowledge-retrieval research supplies neither this pre-edit action window nor the routing handle, so the claim-specific deliverable supports reach above the median but not field-wide 9–10 reach.
